basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Applied AI CPTO | Ships Production AI Products | 3x Founder | MBA | 10M+ Users Served
basics.summary: Technical co-founder profile: builds applied AI products end-to-end, from problem discovery to production traffic. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps shipping multi-agent systems on GCP (2x outbound conversions, $1M forecast quarterly). 3 AI companies founded on the side (SwissNRI fintech, Proplab real-estate vision AI, PulseView explainable trading AI), all live and shipping. 13+ years across product, architecture, hiring, and GTM; MBA-trained (Quantic, 93.2%); ready to be the CPTO who turns an outlier idea into a €1B applied-AI company.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Own product and tech end-to-end for a 0 to 1 AI product: multi-agent workflows (Python, LangGraph, Google ADK on GCP Vertex AI) exposed to reps via MCP servers with agent state streamed over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M/quarter forecast revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. The moat for any applied-AI company: trust in data.
Report directly to C-level on outcomes. Own architecture, eval pipelines (LangSmith), cost telemetry, tool-selection tuning, on-call. Product-tech leadership without a middle layer.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead of Incubation, reporting to CIO. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Built the team, owned the product, ran GTM with Sales and PM.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. Product Owner mindset: identified the spend, framed the solution, shipped, killed the contract.

Product Owner of Beekeeper Template Engine: cut customer setup 90%, now powers 15% of assets created on the platform (10M+ users). Owned the technical investigations, epic definition, and vision-setting.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist and GenAI demo system for Sales; ran observability and on-call for global production; hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness for seed-to-VC investment decisions. Sit on the technology evaluation panel.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading; advised founders on hiring, AI strategy, and building companies that actually ship.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for EPFL spin-off autonomous drone delivery. Shipped end-to-end platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS) powering 500+ real-world deliveries. Closed Unilever partnership and CES Las Vegas showcase.
Engineered flight control APIs and logistics optimization: 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record. Built CI/CD and cloud infra from scratch.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax platform for Swiss-Indian families. RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions with citations back to the regulation; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users file. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate
projects.description: Applied-AI platform for small real estate teams. Vision pipeline extracts structured signals (room type, condition, defects) from inspection photos; LLM agents turn those records into multilingual, marketing-ready listings end-to-end.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence platform for retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals with explainability built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship.
